description:
Rank areas by market per competing business for a category (the opportunity score).

    Each area gets a yearly market in euros, estimated competing businesses and an opportunity
    score against its region, all with ranges. Areas are ranked by the cautious (low) end of
    the score; areas too small for the category are left out and counted. Use for "where in
    Valladolid should I open a gym" or "which towns in Málaga province lack pharmacies".

category.description: Business category: restaurant, cafe, bar, fast_food, bakery, butcher, greengrocer, supermarket, pharmacy, optician, dentist, physiotherapy, hairdresser, beauty_salon, veterinary, gym, childcare, private_school, clothes, home. Plain words work too ('gyms', 'peluquerías').
category.title: Category

level.description: 'district' or 'tract' within a municipality; 'municipality' within a province or region.
level.title: Level

limit.description: How many areas to return, best first.
limit.title: Limit

within.description: A municipality (compares its districts or tracts) or a province or region (compares its municipalities).
within.title: Within

name: compare_areas

mapping_completeness.description: Mapped pharmacies and bars per resident vs the region; under 0.5 the map looks thin.
mapping_completeness.title: Mapping Completeness

market_eur.description: Yearly household spending pool for the category, euros.

market_per_business.description: Euros per year per business (one pseudo-business added).

score.description: Market per business relative to the region; 1.0 = same as the region. None if too small.

thin_map.description: Mapping looks too thin to trust the supply estimate.
thin_map.title: Thin Map

visitor_eur.description: Foreign visitors' share of market_eur (Spanish visitors raise only the high end).

visitor_hotel_nights.description: Hotel nights in the last 12 months by origin (domestic, foreign).
visitor_hotel_nights.title: Visitor Hotel Nights

area_names.description: For districts and tracts: OpenStreetMap neighbourhood names inside it (not official INE names).
area_names.title: Area Names

code.description: INE code. Pass this to other tools.
code.title: Code

match.description: How the query matched. 'fuzzy' means a spelling guess: confirm it. 'neighbourhood' means a neighbourhood name was found inside this INE district.
match.title: Match

matched_name.description: The neighbourhood name that matched, if any.
matched_name.title: Matched Name

official_name.description: INE's form of the name when it differs ('Palmas de Gran Canaria, Las').
official_name.title: Official Name

Source.description: Where a figure comes from. Every number in `data` must trace to one of these.

data_period.description: Reference date or year of the data, e.g. '2025-01-01' or '2023'.
data_period.title: Data Period

dataset_id.description: Upstream identifier, e.g. INE table id '29005'.
dataset_id.title: Dataset Id

publisher.description: Organisation that publishes the data, e.g. 'INE'.
publisher.title: Publisher

retrieved_at.description: When this server fetched the data from upstream (UTC).
retrieved_at.title: Retrieved At

url.description: URL a person can open to see the data.
url.title: Url

Source.title: Source

confidence.description: Lowest confidence across inputs: high, medium or low. Never state a conclusion more strongly than this.
confidence.title: Confidence
